current_answer: OpenAI plugins are installable packages of reusable skills, tool connections or both. The universal plugin directory distributes them for supported hosts, not universal execution or access. Builders should keep essential required-policy/input handling in the proposed core and make local lifecycle helpers optional and environment-qualified; installation, trust, execution and actual policy use are separate evidence. Skill instructions and hook checks are not an enforced compliance boundary.
